cluster.headline: ה-AI משנה את שוק העבודה: מספר מחפשי העבודה במקצועות החשופים זינק ב-52%
cluster.body_note: Plain curl returned 403; body obtained via WebFetch (rendered page summarized, not verbatim; no JSON-LD articleBody present in fetched content). On-page article title: 'שירות התעסוקה: המקצועות במשק שכבר לא יכולים בלי AI' (homepage headline differs). Author Lior Bakalo, 25.11.26 06:00. Body: new Israel Employment Service report; job seekers from highly AI-exposed occupations up 52% vs Jan 2022 (just before ChatGPT) to ~38k, ~a quarter of all job seekers; moderately exposed +25%; non-exposed -23%; ~half of increase from high-tech; software-developer job seekers more than tripled since Oct 2022 to ~8,900; exposure index based on Anthropic's Claude-usage task index adapted to Israeli occupations, not actual AI use in Israel; authors say data do not prove AI displaced workers; ~39% of job seekers aged 40 from high-exposure occupations; Tel Aviv ~46% vs North ~20%.
